title: Replicating CAA refusal steering on a non-Llama model family (Qwen vs. Gemma)

original_idea.body: Reproduce CAA refusal vector extraction on Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Gemma-2-2B-it using public contrast pairs, comparing best layer, coefficient-coherence tradeoff, and whether refusal is one-dimensional.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: family-portability of refusal steering affects safety tooling reuse, but a replication with a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Open-source CAA code, public contrast pairs, small models; accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped replication with fixed methodology.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Replication/portability infra labs underweight, open models.

novelty.reasoning: CAA refusal across families is a direct replication; largely addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Mostly covered by existing cross-model work.
